name: RUCC
summary: Business Internet services provider ('The Really Useful Communications Company'), founded 1993 in Prahran, Melbourne; now operating from the NSW North Coast (New Brighton) with VIC and NSW presence. Continuous 30-year operation: dialup-era ISP through to business connectivity, web/mail hosting (webmail Australia/Asia/Europe portals) and Mailguard services.
aliases: The Really Useful Communications Company Pty. Ltd

events.details: Founded 1993 (self-published site history); business Internet solutions provider based at Prahran, Melbourne. rucc.net.au captured by the Wayback Machine from 14 Nov 1996, demonstrating a continuous web presence since. Principal: Russell John Green.
